name: Silhouette-based Edge Sampling for Directly Visible Surfaces
definition: A method to efficiently sample boundary integrals for directly visible surfaces by identifying and sampling only silhouette edges, reducing variance compared to uniform edge sampling.
summary: Silhouette-based Edge Sampling reduces variance by classifying and sampling only silhouette edges, distinguishing itself from uniform edge sampling by filtering out non-silhouette edges that do not contribute to boundaries.
